Four-Year-Old Boy Rescued After Falling Into Deep Borewell in Ambala

A four-year-old boy named Nirbhay fell into a 220-foot deep borewell in Ambala, Haryana. Rescue operations involving multiple agencies, including the army and NDRF, were launched to save the child. The incident has drawn comparisons to a similar event in 2006 involving a boy named Prince. The rescue efforts faced challenges, including a leak in the borewell.
